subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should current-turn image resolution forward partial native images when some same-turn Telegram/channel attachments fail, or keep the current all-or-nothing fallback until a richer alignment contract exists?
rationale: Current main has an explicit fallback expectation, while the open closing PR changes user-visible image delivery semantics in a shared channel path and still needs proof.

options.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
options.body: Allow partial native forwarding only after preserving failed attachment positions through the downstream prompt-image boundary and collecting real transport proof.

options.title: Keep fallback behavior
options.body: Preserve the current all-or-nothing fallback and close or narrow the linked PR if partial native delivery is not the desired contract.

options.title: Defer under this issue
options.body: Leave the issue and linked PR open while maintainers settle the broader Telegram native-vision contract.

recommendation.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
recommendation.body: Allow partial native forwarding only after preserving failed attachment positions through the downstream prompt-image boundary and collecting real transport proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc recently owned the same resolver's mixed image-order contract and Telegram prompt-media-path area.
